name: ios-screens
description: Build iPhone app screens that feel native instead of like a website in an app. Use when designing or building iOS UI in SwiftUI, UIKit, React Native, Expo or Flutter: navigation and tab bars, lists, forms, sheets, onboarding, settings, paywalls, permissions and empty states. Follows Apple conventions (safe areas, Dynamic Type, dark mode, 44pt targets) and checks the result on small and large iPhones. Real iOS app screens from UXKIN are optional.
